name: MonarchMultiSelect
title: MultiSelect
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with MonarchSearchBar and an androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of toggleable rows with androidx.compose.material3.Checkbox marks; MonarchTag (androidx.compose.material3.AssistChip) for the chosen values, MonarchButton and MonarchFormField
summary: A field for choosing several values from a long list, searched in a bottom sheet, with the chosen values shown as removable tags.
whenToUse: For several values from a list too long to show at once: teams, labels, countries, skills.
whenNotToUse: For one value use MonarchCombobox or MonarchSelect. For a few fixed options use MonarchCheckboxGroup. For free text values use MonarchTagInput. For people and records with pictures use MonarchEntityPicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMultiSelect(label: String, options: List<MonarchComboboxOption>, selected: List<String>, onSelectedChange: (List<String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, required: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, sortByMatch: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, maxSelections: Int? = null, limit: Int? = null, query: String? = null, onQueryChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, filter: ((MonarchComboboxOption, String) -> Boolean)? = null, onCreate: ((String) -> MonarchComboboxOption?)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchMultiSelectLabels = MonarchMultiSelectLabels())

class MonarchMultiSelectLabels(select: String? = null, change: String? = null, done: String? = null, none: String? = null, count: ((count: Int, max: Int) -> String)? = null, remove: ((label: String) -> String)? = null, list: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the button and is the title of the sheet.

options.name: options
options.description: The options in order, with the same fields as a combobox option: label, description, hint, group, keywords and enabled.

options.name: selected
options.description: The ids of the chosen options, in the order they were picked.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with every chosen id after each pick or removal.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the field.

options.name: enabled
options.description: When false the button and the tags' remove buttons do nothing and take the disabled colors.

options.name: required
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the button's name.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows "Loading…" in the list while nothing matches.

options.name: sortByMatch
options.description: While searching, lists labels that start with the text first, then labels with a word that does.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: The button's text while nothing is chosen. "Select…" when null.

options.name: helperText
options.description: Guidance under the field.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message, shown under the field and set as the button's error.

options.name: maxSelections
options.description: The most values that can be chosen. Other rows are disabled at the limit and "2 of 3 selected" shows under the field and in the sheet.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows at most this many matches, with a note to keep typing.

options.name: query
options.description: The search text, for a server search, with onQueryChange and a filter that keeps every option. Kept inside when null; cleared when the sheet closes.

options.name: onQueryChange
options.description: Called with the search text on every keystroke, and with "" when the sheet closes.

options.name: filter
options.description: Decides whether an option matches. By default the label, hint and keywords are searched, ignoring case and accents.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Offers "Create “text”" when no label equals the typed text and the limit is not reached. The returned option is chosen.

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: The icon of each tag's remove button. Monarch bundles no icons; without it tags are plain and values are removed in the sheet.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings; list takes the combobox list strings (search, loading, empty, create, more).

states.name: empty
states.description: No tags; the secondary button shows the prompt.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The picks are tags in pick order above a ghost button that reads "Edit selection".

states.name: open
states.description: A bottom sheet with the label as its title, the count when there is a limit, a search field, the checklist under group headings and Done; it stays open between picks.

states.name: limit reached
states.description: Rows that are not chosen are disabled and Create is not offered; chosen rows can still be removed.

states.name: loading
states.description: The list shows "Loading…" while nothing matches.

states.name: error
states.description: The message shows under the field with the form field's error style and is set on the button.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Text takes the disabled colors and the button and tag remove buttons do nothing.

appearance: Tags use the neutral tag colors, the button the secondary or ghost button colors, the sheet the surface role with check marks in the accent solid role and unchecked boxes in the input border role; descriptions, hints, headings and the count use the muted text role. All come from MonarchTheme in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web opens a popover listbox under an input with chips; on Android the list opens in a Material 3 bottom sheet with a search field, the pattern of system pickers, and the chips sit above a button, as on iOS. The web submits values as hidden form inputs (name); a Compose app reads the hoisted list instead. Matching, ordering, grouping, the limit note and Create are shared with MonarchCombobox. Tags are removable only when the app gives a removeIcon, because Monarch bundles no icons. The web's server search with onSearch and an AbortSignal becomes query and onQueryChange with app-side loading, as in MonarchCombobox. Same name as iOS.
accessibility: The button is one element named by the field's label (with "Required" when required); its state description is the chosen labels joined with commas, or "None".
The error is set on the button and announced through the form field's polite live region.
Each tag's remove button is named "Remove" with the value's label and has a 48dp target.
In the sheet each option row is one checkbox element with its label, description and hint; disabled and over-limit rows are read as disabled.
Group headings are headings; Loading, No matches and the count are polite live regions.
The button and every row are at least 48dp high.
edgeCases: A chosen id with no option is shown as the id itself, so a value from an older list stays visible and removable.
Creating an option that is already chosen does not remove it.
At the limit, Create is hidden; a new pick needs a removal first.
Long labels wrap in the tags and in the rows; the button keeps its own short text.

examples.title: In a Field, controlled
examples.template:
MonarchMultiSelect(
    label = {{label}},
    options = options,
    selected = labels,
    onSelectedChange = { labels = it },
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
    helperText = {{description}},
    removeIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
)
examples.code:
MonarchMultiSelect(
    label = "Labels",
    options = options,
    selected = labels,
    onSelectedChange = { labels = it },
    placeholder = "Add labels",
    helperText = "Type to filter. Picked labels show as chips.",
    removeIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
)
